Fresh homemade sourdough

Made with 100% starter and no added yeast, baked to order and slow-fermented in my kitchen. The plain loaf has only three ingredients: flour, water, and salt. I bake up to three times a week, about four loaves per batch. Tell me what you’d like and I’ll fit your order into the next batch.

How it works

  1. Tell me what you want.
    Send a request below with the loaf and when you’d like pickup.
  2. I put it in a batch.
    Your order goes into a bake this week or the following week. I confirm your date by message.
  3. Pick up or get it delivered.
    Pick up at Brown or have it delivered nearby for a small fee. Pay by cash or Venmo.

Questions

What goes in the bread?

The plain loaf is just flour, water, and salt, fermented with my sourdough starter. No commercial yeast, no additives. The flavored loaves add only the ingredients in their name.

How do I store it?

Keep it cut-side down on a board for two days, then slice and freeze. Toast straight from the freezer.

Can I get a loaf every week?

Yes. Tell me in the notes and I’ll hold one for you each batch.
